newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Talk to NZ government re high NZ dollar - Peters.
newsitem.headline: Talk to NZ government re high NZ dollar - Peters.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters on Wednesday said people should talk to the caretaker National government regarding the New Zealand dollar, which hit an 8-1/2 year today.
"On the question of the currency, you should talk to the existing government and those that put the existing monetary regime into place," Peters told reporters at a news conference.
Peters said NZ First was not responsible for the rise in the New Zealand dollar. "We cannot be held responsible until such time as we become part of a future government," he said.
Asked how he would bring the dollar down, Peters said to read his party's manifesto, for which he said there was a growing respectability.
